services.name: Bed cleanup and weeding

services.name: Mulch installation
services.blurb: Hardwood mulch by the cubic yard, two to three inches deep, depth checked with a ruler.

services.name: New construction beds
services.blurb: Bare-dirt beds on a new house measured, edged and covered before the first rain.

services.name: Move-in and move-out refresh

services.name: Annual programs

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: I grew up baling straw outside Lakeland, so I counted. Ticket said 52 bales, I counted 52 empty strings in the trailer. Coverage was right too, I stuck a ruler in two beds and got a little over three inches.
reviews.name: Hoyt B.

reviews.text: We were leaving Moody on orders and needed the beds done before the move-out inspection. They measured, gave me a count by text, and it was finished two days later.
reviews.name: Shanice T.

reviews.text: The bale counter on their site said 38. The crew's measurement came out at 40 because of a bed I forgot behind the shed. They showed me the sketch, which I appreciated.
reviews.name: Rodney F.

reviews.text: Delivery only, 30 bales. Stacked on a tarp by the garage like I asked and not one short.
reviews.name: Opal M.

reviews.text: New house, bare red dirt everywhere. They edged and covered every bed in one day, and the straw was long and bright, not the short broken stuff we got from the store last year.
reviews.name: Javon C.

reviews.text: On the annual plan for two years now. Same count each time, a text the day before, done by lunch. My husband likes that the invoice lists bales and square feet, not just a total.
reviews.name: Wilma S.

reviews.text: Had them pull weeds and redo the beds around a rental. They wrote down how many bags of weeds they hauled, which helped when I billed the old tenant.
reviews.name: Clay N.

proof.guarantee: If your ticket says more bales than we spread, every missing bale comes off the bill.

prices.note: about 35 sq ft per bale at 3 in
